autoVerifyHint: Compare samples after collection. When off, verify the saved samples manually.
confidenceUnavailable: Confidence is unavailable. It requires three valid samples and a calibrated reference bank. Retry to complete the samples; the ranking alone is not a percentage.
configSaved: UA, headers and detection options are saved on the server.
configSaveError: Settings could not be saved. Edit a setting to retry.
cost: Detection sends three sampling requests and uses API credits. Synchronizing the catalog does not create keys or run detection.
deleteScheduleConfirm: Delete schedule “{{name}}”? Its saved detection history will be retained.
description: Choose an existing account or API credential and synchronize its keys and model catalog.
effortHint: Default, or a supported value such as xhigh
emptyResult: Select a model and start detection to view candidates.
failed: Detection failed. Check the endpoint and credentials.
headersInvalid: Request headers must be a JSON object containing string values.
historyHint: Manual and scheduled results are saved on the server, including partial samples and failures.
loginRequired: Your login has expired. Reload this page and sign in again.
looseHint: Finish streaming when the target count is reached; trim extra numbers from complete responses.
modelRestricted: This key does not allow the selected model. Choose another key or model.
noKeys: No usable inference key. Add or recover a key in Key Management or the API Credential Library.
noModels: No models returned. You can enter a model name manually.
noRanking: No valid ranking was produced. Review the sampling details.
noSchedules: No schedules. Create one from the selected model.
parallelHint: Send all three samples together; turn off to request them sequentially.
probabilityScope: Confidence is the relative probability within the reference bank. All candidates sum to 100%; models outside the bank are not included.
required: Choose a credential and model, or enter a Base URL, API key and model.
resultMeaning: Results compare model behavior with the reference bank and cannot prove model identity.
scheduleCost: Enabled jobs make three real sampling requests per run and use API credits. Pausing cancels an active run and stops future runs; history is retained.
scheduleHint: Choose a source and model above, then save a schedule. Jobs run on the VPS while this page is closed.
scheduleInvalid: Enter a schedule name and an interval of at least 5 whole minutes.
sourceHint: Choose a saved source to load its inference key and models.
streamHint: Display sample text as it arrives.
title: Model fingerprint
verificationPending: Samples are saved. Verify them now without sending new requests to the model.
